data.description: Observed once during the T&S run (2026-07-07 ~08:15, prod c11): after heavy surface churn (spawn/close of ~10 surfaces over 5h), a new-split-created pane (pane:58/surface:167, visible, selected, real bounds 1168x551) accepted surface.send_text (OK) but send_key and read-screen returned 'internal_error: Surface not ready' / 'Terminal surface not found' for 30s+; the shell never appeared; text sends vanished. A sibling tab in an existing pane (created same session) worked fine. Workaround: close the wedged surface and reuse an established one. Suggest: make send_text fail loudly when the PTY is unwired (silent OK is the dangerous half), and investigate late-session PTY allocation. Evidence in .lattice/orchestration/run-state.md footguns + RUN-REPORT.md.
data.title: Surface-init wedge: fresh surface accepts send (OK) but PTY never wires; send-key/read-screen fail 'Surface not ready'

data.body: The 1.0 fix for a terminal whose PTY never attaches is C11-295 (cold start, ledger B003) and C11-296 (a screen read starts a cold terminal, ledger B087). C11-295 depends on the Ghostty mailbox patch set C11-294. This ticket stays the incident record. Do not open another PTY-start fix.
